tools.description:
Performs a search across multiple Workspace corpora (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and Chat) based on the provided query.

This tool is a cross-corpus search tool that by default fans out to all supported corpora (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and Chat). If the user's query does not specify a particular corpus (e.g., "where am i planning to go for my photography walks in june?"), you MUST call this cross-corpus "search_corpus" tool first, rather than calling specific tools like "list_events", "search_threads", "list_threads", or "search_files". If this tool returns no results, you can then fallback to these per-product (single-corpus) search tools.

Note that if the user specifies a particular corpus in their query (e.g., "search for content in my email"), it is recommended to use a single-corpus tool, such as the GmailTool, for more focused results if available. However, this cross-corpus search tool will still function for those queries, and should be used if specific tools are not available.

This tool can filter results based on a query string. Pagination is not supported for cross-corpus search. Note that if a Gmail message contains attachments, they are not returned as a separate field; instead, attachment details will be included directly within the message's snippet.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of results to return. If not set, a default page size will be used.

pageToken.description: Optional. The page token to use for pagination.

query.description: Required. The raw query string provided by the user.

tools.name: search_corpus

CalendarResult.description: Represents a search result from Google Calendar.

calendarId.description: The calendar id of the Calendar event, which is the owner's email address.

description.description: The description of the Calendar event.

end.description: The end time of the Calendar event (exclusive).

eventId.description: Unique identifier for the Calendar event.

location.description: Represents the location of the Calendar event.

start.description: The start time of the Calendar event (inclusive).

title.description: The title of the Calendar event.

viewUrl.description: The URL to view the Calendar event.

ChatAttachment.description: Metadata for an attachment in a chat message.

x-google-enum-descriptions: The file is a Google Drive file.
The file is uploaded to Chat.

ChatMessage.description: Represents a message in a chat conversation.

createTime.description: Timestamp when the message was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the message and thread.

plaintextBody.description: Plain text body of the message.

reactionSummaries.description: The emoji reactions summary included in the message.

threadedReply.description: Whether message is a thread reply.

viewUrl.description: The URL to view the Chat message.

ChatMessageId.description: Represents a unique identifier for a chat message.

threadId.description: The thread this message belongs to.

ChatReaction.description: Summary of emoji reactions on a chat message.

count.description: The total number of reactions using the associated emoji.

emoji.description: The emoji unicode string or custom emoji name.

ChatResult.description: Represents a search result from Google Chat.

messages.description: A list of messages that could be grouped together as a conversation.

ChatUser.description: Represents a user in Google Chat.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

DateOrDateTime.description: LINT.IfChange(DateOrDateTime) A date or date-time with optional timezone. Set date or date_time, but not both.

date.description: ISO 8601 date at midnight UTC (for example, `'2019-11-20T00:00:00Z'`).

timeZone.description: The original time zone in IANA Time Zone Database format (for example, `'America/Los_Angeles'`). The returned `'date_time'` might be in a different display time zone (for example the viewer's current time zone).

DriveResult.description: Represents a search result from Google Drive.

contentSnippet.description: The content snippet of the Drive item.

itemId.description: Unique identifier for the Drive item (e.g., document, sheet, presentation).

mimeType.description: The mime type of the Drive item.

title.description: The title of the Drive item.

viewUrl.description: The URL to view the Drive item.

ccRecipients.description: The cc recipients' email addresses of the Gmail message.

recipients.description: The recipients' email addresses of the Gmail message.

sender.description: The sender's email address of the Gmail message.

snippet.description: The content snippet of the Gmail message.

subject.description: The subject of the Gmail message.

viewUrl.description: The URL to view the Gmail message.

GmailResult.description: Represents a search result from Gmail.

thread.description: The thread that match the search query.

messages.description: A list of messages in the thread.

SearchResultItem.description: Represents a single search result item, which can originate from various corpora.

calendarResult.description: A search result from Google Calendar.

chatResult.description: A search result from Google Chat.

driveResult.description: A search result from Google Drive.

items.description: A list of universal search result items, each potentially from a different corpus.

nextPageToken.description: The next page token to use for pagination.
